name: terse
description: Four user-invoked skills for documentation. `audit` measures it: fresh readers answer the questions your readers arrive with, and every claim about behaviour is checked against the code that backs it. `rethink` decides what a document should be — what the genre already solved, what things are called, what is said in what order — and stops at a skeleton for your word. `rewrite` writes it, in a loop of critics that do not overlap rather than one pass. `calibrate` measures which forms of writing one person actually prefers. Nothing is written into your tree without you.
